dedupe_keys.name: arrets de bus du tec a chaudfontaine

description: Arrêts de bus du TEC à Chaudfontaine is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by TEC. Ce jeu contient les données théoriques du TEC au format GTFS (arrêts, lignes, voyages, heures de départ et d'arrivée aux arrêts, périodes de circulation, tracés). Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are tec, mobilité, arrêts. The portal shows 200 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-09-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons - CC0 (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
